whoosh_soft_a.use: quick card / panel slide, short camera nudge (peak at 0.32 s)
whoosh_soft_a.how: pink+white noise through a TPT band-pass arcing 380->1900->700 Hz (Q 1.4), faint resonant pitch band, decorrelated air, pan L->R

whoosh_soft_b.use: page-to-page move, UI card lifting out of the page (peak at 0.44 s)
whoosh_soft_b.how: as whoosh_soft_a, slower and darker: band-pass 300->1500->520 Hz (Q 1.2), pan R->L

whoosh_soft_c.use: bigger camera move / scene transition (peak at 0.69 s)
whoosh_soft_c.how: as whoosh_soft_a, longest of the three: band-pass 240->1250->420 Hz (Q 1.0), wide pan

whoosh_long.use: 2 s camera fly-through (corridor, into the 3D scene); peak at 1.2 s
whoosh_long.how: two noise layers (low body 150->700->260 Hz and high air 1.2->4.2->1.6 kHz), a quiet 46 Hz pressure swell, full L->R eased pan

swipe_up.use: upward swipe / card flicked up / panel rising (peak at 0.30 s)
swipe_up.how: noise band-pass rising 650 Hz -> 5.2 kHz (Q 1.6) with a quiet sine glide 520 -> 1560 Hz under it

ui_click_a.use: cursor click on a button / link (crisp, soft)
ui_click_a.how: damped sines 1.75 kHz + 620 Hz with a 0.3 ms raised-cosine onset + a 2 ms band-passed noise tick at 3.2 kHz, low-passed 8 kHz, touch of small room

ui_click_b.use: rounder click: toggle, select a bot / date, confirm a choice
ui_click_b.how: damped sines 1.15 kHz + 380 Hz + 2.4 kHz noise tick, low-passed 6.5 kHz, small room

ui_tick.use: tiny tick: counter step, list item, cursor hover tick, timestamp digit
ui_tick.how: damped sine 2.35 kHz (D7) + quiet octave + 1 ms noise tick at 5.2 kHz, 0.3 ms onset

ui_hover.use: tiny airy blip: hover over a card, a pill lighting up
ui_hover.how: sine gliding E6 -> F#6 over 50 ms with 6 ms onset + breathy band-passed noise, small room

ui_pop.use: soft bubble: an agent raises its cube, a chip/badge appears, a dot lands
ui_pop.how: sine with a fast upward pitch glide 280 -> 920 Hz (bubble resonance), 2 ms onset, 28 ms decay, quiet 2nd harmonic, low-passed 3.5 kHz

key_soft_a.use: gentle keyboard typing (use a..d in rotation, 60-110 ms apart, +-1.5 dB)
key_soft_a.how: laptop-key model: low thump (damped sine ~210 Hz) + soft plastic tick (noise band-pass ~1.9 kHz, 4 ms) + keycap ring, bottom-out 9 ms later, faint release tick ~80 ms later; low-passed 6.5 kHz

key_soft_b.how: as key_soft_a with thump 240 Hz, tick 2.3 kHz, release at 86 ms

key_soft_c.use: typing, variant c (slightly darker; good for the space bar / enter)
key_soft_c.how: as key_soft_a with thump 190 Hz, tick 1.7 kHz, release at 95 ms

key_soft_d.how: as key_soft_a with thump 260 Hz, tick 2.1 kHz, release at 72 ms

glass_chime_a.use: clean glass chime, A5 (880 Hz): a station lights up, a block settles, a soft accent
glass_chime_a.how: additive glass partials 1 / 2 / 3.01 / 4.18 / 5.43 / 6.79 with per-partial decay (upper ones die fast), slow-beating twin fundamental, 2.5 ms raised-cosine onset, synthetic hall (RT60 1.9 s)

glass_chime_b.use: clean glass chime, D6 (1175 Hz) - the tonic; pairs with a and c (D major pentatonic)

glass_chime_c.use: clean glass chime, F#6 (1480 Hz) - brightest of the three
glass_chime_c.how: as glass_chime_a on F#6, slightly darker partial balance

glass_seal.use: HERO 'committed / sealed on-chain' moment. Sync point = the chime at 0.60 s
glass_seal.how: 0-0.6 s: air swell (noise band-pass sweeping 1.2 -> 4.2 kHz) and a warm sub swell (D2 + D3 sines, slow raised-cosine rise) leading in; at 0.6 s a strummed glass chord D5-A5-D6-F#6 (16 ms apart), a soft warm body (D4 + A4, 25 ms onset) and three tiny sparkles; big synthetic hall (RT60 2.8 s). No transient.

lock_click.use: small precise latch: a padlock / lock icon closes, a rule is locked (sync = 2nd click, 32 ms)
lock_click.how: two micro-clicks 32 ms apart (engage + seat), each damped sines (2.9/1.5 kHz, then 2.3/1.2 kHz) over a small body (650/520 Hz, 7-9 ms), 0.25 ms onsets, tiny room

success.use: 3-note rising chime: verification passed, all stations lit, task done
success.how: glass notes A5 -> D6 -> F#6, 100 ms apart, rising velocity, hall (RT60 1.9 s)

notify.use: a chat message arrives (Telegram reply, agent answer), soft
notify.how: two short 'glass-marimba' notes B5 -> E6 85 ms apart (fast-decaying partials) + a soft puff of air

coin.use: payment confirmed (x402 pay-per-signal), soft and pleasant
coin.how: two bright glass notes D6 -> A6 75 ms apart with a faint inharmonic 2.76x 'coin' partial, then a few soft sparkle grains; hall

data_blip_a.use: tiny high data ping: a row updates, a packet arrives, a counter ticks over
data_blip_a.how: sine D7 (2349 Hz) with 1.5 ms onset and 16 ms decay over a quiet A6

data_blip_b.use: double data ping (A6 -> E7): a request + its answer, a chain confirmation
data_blip_b.how: two sine pips 45 ms apart, 1 ms onsets, 10-12 ms decays

shimmer.use: 1 s sparkle on glass: crystal glints, a card turns into light, the logo catches light
shimmer.how: granular cloud of ~42 short glass grains on D-major-pentatonic notes (1.2-3.5 kHz, weighted low), density rising to 0.35 s then thinning, random pan, faint high air, hall (RT60 1.9 s)

riser_2s.use: 2 s build into a cut / reveal (sync point = END of file)
riser_2s.how: pink+white noise through a TPT low-pass opening 260 Hz -> 7 kHz (late curve) with growing resonance and rising high-pass, + D3/A3/D4 saw chord gliding up an octave; ~30 dB rise, peaks at 96 %, shaped to 0

riser_4s.use: 4 s build (section lift, 'open' build) - sync point = END of file

downlifter.use: settle after a peak: bright air falling away, a quiet two-note tone easing down a fourth
downlifter.how: noise low-pass sweeping 7 kHz -> 650 Hz, quiet A4 + D5 sines easing down 5 semitones (never to zero, so not a tape-stop), narrowing stereo, 25 ms soft onset; sync point = start

sub_swell.use: gentle low swell under a big moment (no punch); sync point = its peak at 1.3 s
sub_swell.how: D2 sine + 2nd/3rd harmonics (so laptops hear it), 1.3 s raised-cosine rise, 0.55 s release

reveal_bloom.use: airy pad bloom for the logo / headline reveal; sync point = start
reveal_bloom.how: Dmaj9 pad (D3 A3 C#4 E4 F#4 A4, 5-voice detuned PolyBLEP saws + sine body) through a low-pass that blooms 320 Hz -> 3.2 kHz in 0.9 s then settles, high air, two glass notes (D6, A6), big hall (RT60 2.8 s)

format: 48 kHz, 24-bit PCM WAV; peak -1.5 dBFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP; anchor = sync point (s)

whoosh.wav.use: very short (0.15 s) low air swish: a quick cut, a small card flick; darker than sfx2 whooshes
whoosh.wav.processing: 48 kHz 24-bit, DC high-pass 22 Hz, 2 ms / 12 ms raised-cosine edge fades, peak -1.5 dBFS

skipped.mouse-click: screen: HF_HEAVY (100 % of energy > 4 kHz) - thin, sharp double click; sfx2/ui_click_a/b instead
skipped.switch: screen: HF_HEAVY (71 % > 4 kHz), starts/ends mid-signal - plasticky click; sfx2/ui_click_b instead
skipped.ding: licence: Remotion says it is 'not explicitly released under a free license' (myinstants) - also 97 % of its energy in 2-6 kHz; sfx2/glass_chime_* instead
skipped.shutter-modern: screen: NOISY_HF + HARSH_ONSET + CRACKLE - mechanical clatter
skipped.page-turn: screen: HF_HEAVY (72 % > 4 kHz); the file is actually Kenney 'Draw Knife 1' (blade scrape)
skipped.whip: briefed out (a whip crack); the file is a racquet swish with a sharp crack transient
skipped.snapchat-notification / mac-quack: brand / meme sounds - not ours to borrow for a product launch
skipped.vine-boom / bone-crack / record-scratch: meme, impact, crack or error sounds - banned by the client rule (screen: THUMP / CRACKLE / PITCH_DIVE / ABRUPT_END)

remotion.policy: Taken only if CC0 / free, screened clean (analysis/check_sfx.py) and in the glassy-soft brief.
